name: Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor
author: Wow Elements

sections.description:
Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor is a feature-rich plugin crafted to supercharge the Elementor page builder with advanced slider widgets that are both powerful and easy to use. Ideal for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, Wow Sliders enables you to create visually stunning, fully responsive sliders that enhance user engagement and elevate your website’s design.

Whether you’re building a blog, an online store, or a business website, Wow Sliders gives you complete control over your content presentation with highly customizable sliders. The plugin offers:

🎯 Dynamic Content Sliders – Automatically pull content from your blog posts, products, or custom post types into elegant, animated sliders.

🛒 WooCommerce Product Sliders – Showcase your products with beautifully designed carousels and promotional sliders that increase conversions.

🎥 Video & Image Sliders – Add multimedia-rich sliders with smooth transitions, lightbox options, and autoplay controls.

🖼️ Hero Sliders – Create impactful landing sections with full-width hero sliders and interactive call-to-action buttons.

💡 Wow Sliders – Powerful Slider Widgets for Elementor

Wow Sliders extends Elementor with a set of lightweight, performance-focused slider widgets designed to enhance your website’s creativity and usability — without sacrificing speed.

🎯 **FREE WIDGETS COLLECTION**

🎠 Slider & Carousel Widgets

  1. Image Carousel – A coverflow-filled Swiper effect that brings your image slides to life with smooth transitions and customizable navigation.
  2. Super Flow – A smooth, animated slider with advanced flow effects and seamless transitions for stunning visual presentations.
  3. Hero Showcase – Create impactful full-width hero sections with dynamic showcase sliders and interactive call-to-action buttons.
  4. Expo – An exposition-style slider that beautifully highlights your content with bold, immersive layouts and transitions.
  5. Kornel – A creative slider with unique effects and customizable content areas for standout presentations.
  6. Material – A Material Design-inspired slider with clean transitions, layered content, and modern card-style layouts.
  7. Shutters – A dramatic shutter-effect slider with split-panel transitions that create a bold, cinematic look.
  8. Lumix – A photography-focused slider with sharp, high-impact layouts designed to showcase images in their best light.
  9. Pixora – A pixel-perfect creative slider with artistic transitions and flexible content positioning.
  10. Testimo – A testimonial slider built to display client reviews and social proof with elegant, trust-building layouts.

🚀 **PRO WIDGETS — Coming Soon**

  1. Post Slider – Dynamically display blog posts in a slider layout with customizable query options.
  2. WooCommerce Slider – Showcase WooCommerce products in a beautiful slider with filtering support.
  3. Video Slider – Display videos in an engaging slider layout with autoplay and lightbox options.
  4. Media Slider – A versatile slider supporting images, videos, and mixed media content.
  5. Blog Slider – A blog-focused slider with post excerpts, featured images, and meta information.
  6. Events Slider – Display upcoming events in a dynamic, date-aware slider layout.
  7. Creative Slider – Advanced creative slider with custom animation presets and transition effects.
  8. Scrolling Slider – Infinite-scroll slider for seamless continuous content display.

More widgets and features are coming soon…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload wow-sliders-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor and searching for “Wow Sliders” widgets.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor is compatible with all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Wow Sliders along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential slider widgets to help you create stunning pages in minutes.

Can I enable or disable individual widgets?

  • Yes! Head to Wow Sliders → Widgets in your WordPress admin dashboard. You can toggle each widget on or off individually, helping you keep your site lean and fast.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video tutorials to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support?

  • When we release an update version, you will automatically get a notification in the WordPress plugin manager so you can update from there. If you want to update manually, just contact us and we will send you the update version via email.
